senses.gloss: m. (נָסַק; sub. מִסִּים &c.) one who levies contributions, in gen. a Roman collector, oppressor (interch. with מֵצִיק).
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Ohalot 16:13">Tosef. Ohol. XVI, 13</cite> (ed. Zuck. <cite ref="M02327"><he>מציק</he></cite>); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 1:3:4">Y. Pes. I, 27ᶜ</cite>; (Bab.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 10:5">B. Kam. X, 5</cite> <he>ונטלוהו מ׳</he> and government officers confiscated it.
Ib. 116ᵇ מאן דאמר מס׳ … מצ׳ וכ׳ he who reads massiḳin is not at fault, nor is he who reads m’tsikin (ref. for the latter to מצוק, Deut. XXVIII, 57, for the former to Chald. סקאה for צלצל, ib. 42).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 16:8:4">Y. Sabb. XVI, end, 15ᵈ</cite> <he>סופך לעשות במ׳</he> thou shalt be forced by the officers.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 6:1:10">Y. Dem. VI, 25ᵇ</cite> <he>מן המ׳ שנו</he> it means that he rented the field from the officers (who had confiscated it).
